sources.title: Quickstart - LocalAI
sources.snippet: Quickstart LocalAI is a free, open-source alternative to OpenAI (Anthropic, etc.), functioning as a drop-in replacement REST API for local inferencing. It allows you to run LLMs, generate images, and produce audio, all locally or on-premises with consumer-grade hardware, supporting multiple model families and architectures. LocalAI comes with a built-in web interface for chatting with models ...
